{{Quote|Don't underestimate her; she's pretty mean, and a heck of a shot.|From Devidia Vennsiol's bounty posting on the Imperial Enforcement Datacore|<ref name="BTDF" />}}
'''Devidia Vennsiol''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]]. The daughter of a powerful local [[Devidia Vennsiol's father|official]], she was spoiled as a [[Youngling/Legends|child]] and began using her good looks and charisma to manipulate boys. Exasperated, her [[Parent/Legends|father]] sent her to [[Unidentified military school|military school]], but it had little effect on her personality. Shortly after finishing school with an unimpressive record, Vennsiol and her boyfriend, [[Dorbus Kyrullus]], broke into a [[Safidine Industries]] [[Unidentified Safidine Industries laboratory|laboratory]]. Stealing several powerful prototype [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], the pair escaped, but Kyrullus was soon captured with much of the weaponry. This left Vennsiol alone on the run with only two of the prototypes. Safidine placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on her head, offering 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for her return [[Death/Legends|dead]] or alive and 70,000 credits for the return of the pistols.

==Biography==
{{Quote|One standard month ago she broke into a Safidine Industries laboratory with her boyfriend, Dorbus Kyrullus.|Vennsiol's bounty posting describes her crime|<ref name="BTDF" />}}
Devidia Vennsiol was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] the [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] of a powerful local [[Devidia Vennsiol's father|official]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]]. As a [[Youngling/Legends|child]], she was spoiled by her [[Parent/Legends|father]], who let her get away with whatever she pleased, and she quickly learned to get men to do what she wanted using her charisma and good looks. When Vennsiol was a teenager, her father placed her in a [[Unidentified military school|military school]] to try and counter the effects of her pampered childhood, but she continued to manipulate men at the school. Apart from learning to use a variety of weapons at the school, Vennsiol's [[Time/Legends|time]] there was not overly productive, and she left with an unimpressive record.<ref name="BTDF" />

Following her time at military school, Vennsiol and a male named [[Dorbus Kyrullus]], whom she had begun dating, broke into a [[Unidentified Safidine Industries laboratory|laboratory]] belonging to [[Safidine Industries]], a weapons contractor that worked with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] was working on a series of high-powered [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] prototypes, with several finished items stored in the facility. Vennsiol and Kyrullus managed to get away with a large number of the prototypes, but Kyrullus was later captured, and many of the weapons were recovered with him. Vennsiol, however, evaded capture and escaped with two prototypes, prompting Safidine to place a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on her head. They offered 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to any individual holding an [[Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificate/Legends|Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificate]] who could bring the criminal in [[Death/Legends|dead]] or alive, with an additional 70,000 credits available if the prototypes were also recovered. One [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the break in and a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] after Vennsiol had been sighted in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the bounty was posted on the [[Imperial Enforcement DataCore/Legends|Imperial Enforcement DataCore]] by the [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]].<ref name="BTDF" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Devidia had always been a spoiled brat.|Vennsiol's bounty posting on the Imperial Enforcement Datacore|<ref name="BTDF" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] female with [[Color/Legends|white]]-and-red [[Hair/Legends|hair]], pale skin, and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Vennsiol chose to wear her hair partially braided into a plait, with a red dot [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on her forehead and another red tattoo on her left [[Limb/Legends|arm]]. She grew up being able to do as she pleased and with the looks and charisma to bend most men to her will. She was able to bluff, intimidate, and persuade others with greater ease than most individuals, and she was also skilled at disguising herself. Vennsiol was also a perceptive individual, especially at determining the motives of others and noticing sounds. Despite her father's displeasure at the route her life was taking by her teenage [[Standard year/Legends|years]], she continued her spoiled behavior, eventually taking it to the next level and actually committing a crime.<ref name="BTDF" />

Vennsiol was a particularly dexterous individual. While at military school, the only skill to which she applied herself was learning how to use weapons&mdash;by the time Vennsiol left the school, she could wield [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistols, [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], and heavy weaponry. She was capable of operating [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and other vehicles, as she was able to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogate]] with a reasonable level of skill. In addition, she was skilled in placing demolitions and using [[Computer/Legends|computers]] as well as [[Technician/Legends|repairing]] and disabling mechanical devices. Vennsiol could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], and [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]], although the only [[Language/Legends|language]] in which she was literate was Basic. She had considerable knowledge of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Politics/Legends|politics]] and organized crime as well as enough knowledge of [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] to be able to appraise the value of many items.<ref name="BTDF" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Devidia escaped and still had two prototype pistols.|Vennsiol's bounty posting|<ref name="BTDF" />}}
During her time on the run, Vennsiol carried the two prototype blaster pistols that remained from her and Kyrullus's robbery as well as a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] and a deluxe [[Security kit/Legends|security kit]]. She chose to wear a revealing piece of fine, black-colored [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and platform [[Boot/Legends|boots]], along with a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] that included dual [[Holster/Legends|holsters]] for the pistols.<ref name="BTDF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Devidia Vennsiol was created as part of the "[[Bounties to Die For]]" article in the [[Star Wars Gamer 6|sixth issue]] of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine series. The article was written by [[S. Mitch Ritchie]] and was illustrated by [[Ramón Pérez]]. The magazines were supplements for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', and the bounties article provided [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] attributes for Vennsiol to allow for her to be used as an enemy or ally in the game. The article did not specify the era of play in which Vennsiol was active to allow for her use in multiple eras, although the bounty posting was made by the Empire<ref name="BTDF" /> and so must have taken place during its existence, after [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
